name: stock-ticker
description: Live stock ticker band above the Claude Code prompt: watch Taiwan and US quotes while Claude works.

refreshSeconds.title: Taiwan refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often Taiwan quotes refresh during market hours. Minimum 5.

usRefreshSeconds.title: US refresh interval (seconds)
usRefreshSeconds.description: How often US quotes refresh during market hours. Minimum 5.

colors.title: Up/down colors
colors.description: red-up: red for gains (Taiwan/China/Japan convention). green-up: green for gains (US/EU convention).

alertPercent.title: Alert threshold (%)
alertPercent.description: Toast once a day when a symbol moves at least this much. 0 turns alerts off.
